meta.subject: hardware: Rework L2 dflush to complete memory writeback responding

en.summary: The commit fixes L2 flush completion so a flush that hits a dirty line does not acknowledge completion until the required memory writeback has finished and the flush has been replayed to completion.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly ties the bug to writeback completion during dflush.
The patch changes central L2 cache RTL, including the bus interface, pipeline metadata, and response generation.
This directly affects memory ordering and external visibility of dirty data.
evidence: l2_axi_bus_interface.sv now records whether a queued writeback originated from a flush and restarts a flush request when that writeback completes.
l2_cache_arb.sv, l2_cache_tag.sv, and l2_cache_read.sv add is_restarted_flush state and propagate it through the L2 pipeline.
l2_cache_update.sv now emits a FLUSH_ACK only when the flush needed no writeback or when the restarted flush pass completes.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache flush that encounters a dirty line cannot be considered complete merely because it launched the dirty writeback. Completion must be tied to the moment when that dirty data is actually committed to the next memory level and the flush has revalidated that no dirty copy remains in the cache. If the controller acknowledges the flush on the first pass, barriers or external observers can proceed while stale data still resides above memory.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush request hits a dirty cache line that requires an eviction or memory writeback before the line can be considered fully flushed.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Acknowledge the flush as soon as the dirty writeback is launched, and remove any replay or restart path that completes the flush only after writeback completion.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: ack on writeback launch and drop restart token
portability_notes: Apply this to cache-maintenance commands that both clean or evict dirty data and return a completion acknowledgement.
The reusable bug is premature acknowledgement, not the exact queue structure used to remember the flush.
If the target design does not literally replay the flush, use the analogous mutation of clearing the in-progress flush as soon as the writeback request is issued.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the maintenance path that handles flush hits on dirty lines.
Remove the bookkeeping that marks an in-flight writeback as belonging to a flush or that requests a second completion pass after writeback finishes.
Allow the flush response or completion bit to be generated on the first pipeline pass whenever the line was found, regardless of whether dirty data still needs to be written back.
Keep the writeback data path intact so the injected bug manifests specifically as early completion rather than missing eviction data.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 restarted-flush path after dirty writeback
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix stores flush provenance with queued writebacks, reissues a flush request after the writeback completes, propagates is_restarted_flush through the pipeline, and suppresses FLUSH_ACK until that restarted flush is complete.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the writeback_queue is_flush bookkeeping and restart_flush_request path in l2_axi_bus_interface.sv, stop propagating is_restarted_flush through l2_cache_arb.sv, l2_cache_tag.sv, and l2_cache_read.sv, and allow l2_cache_update.sv to acknowledge flush on the first pass.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A flush or barrier can retire before dirty data reaches memory, so a following observer may see stale memory contents even though the flush acknowledged success.
evidence_for_injection: The patch adds explicit flush provenance to the writeback queue entry.
The L2 pipeline gained an is_restarted_flush bit solely to distinguish first-pass and post-writeback flush handling.
l2_cache_update.sv changed the FLUSH_ACK condition to exclude dirty-hit first passes.
notes: This is a high-value portable fault pattern for coherence, fence, and DMA visibility testing.
A simpler repository-specific mutation is to force is_completed_flush true on the first pass regardless of l2r_needs_writeback.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 flush 完成条件：当 flush 命中脏行时，只有在所需的内存写回完成并且 flush 重新执行到真正结束后，才允许确认完成。
why_it_counts: 标题明确把该错误与 dflush 期间的 writeback 完成相关联。
补丁修改了核心 L2 cache RTL，包括总线接口、流水线元数据和响应生成逻辑。
它直接影响内存顺序以及脏数据对外部观察者的可见性。
evidence: l2_axi_bus_interface.sv 现在会记录排队的 writeback 是否来自 flush，并在该 writeback 完成后重新发起 flush 请求。
l2_cache_arb.sv、l2_cache_tag.sv 和 l2_cache_read.sv 新增 is_restarted_flush 状态，并沿 L2 流水线传递。
l2_cache_update.sv 现在只有在 flush 无需 writeback，或者重启后的 flush 流程完成时，才会发出 FLUSH_ACK。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 flush 命中脏 cache line 时，不能因为已经发起脏数据写回就认为 flush 完成。只有当脏数据真正提交到下一级存储，并且 flush 已再次确认缓存中不再保留该脏副本时，才能算真正完成。如果控制器在第一次经过时就确认 flush，barrier 或外部观察者就可能在陈旧数据仍停留在上层缓存时继续执行。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 脏行 writeback 完成后的 flush 完成判定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 请求命中脏 cache line，该行在被视为完全 flush 完成前必须先被驱逐或写回到下一级存储。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 一旦脏 writeback 被发起就立即确认 flush，并移除任何只有在 writeback 完成后才重新完成 flush 的 replay 或 restart 路径。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: ack on writeback launch and drop restart token
portability_notes: 把该故障映射到既会清理或驱逐脏数据、又会返回完成确认的 cache 维护命令上。
可复用的核心是过早确认，而不是保存 flush 状态时具体用了什么队列结构。
如果目标设计不会字面上重放 flush，对应的注入方式是在发出 writeback 请求后立即清除 flush in-progress 状态。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位处理 flush 命中脏行的维护路径。
删除那些用于标记在途 writeback 属于 flush、或者在 writeback 完成后触发第二次完成检查的状态记录。
让 flush 响应或完成位在第一次流水线经过时就能生成，只要该 line 被命中即可，而不管脏数据是否仍待写回。
保持 writeback 数据通路不变，使注入后的故障明确表现为过早完成，而不是遗漏驱逐数据。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 脏 writeback 之后的 L2 restarted-flush 路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 flush 来源信息存入 writeback 队列项，在 writeback 完成后重新发起 flush，请求沿流水线携带 is_restarted_flush，并阻止 l2_cache_update.sv 在重启前就发出 FLUSH_ACK。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 l2_axi_bus_interface.sv 中 writeback_queue 的 is_flush 记录和 restart_flush_request 路径，停止在 l2_cache_arb.sv、l2_cache_tag.sv、l2_cache_read.sv 中传递 is_restarted_flush，并允许 l2_cache_update.sv 在第一次经过时就确认 flush。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或 barrier 可能在脏数据真正到达内存之前就退休，因此后续观察者会在 flush 已确认成功的情况下仍看到陈旧内存内容。
evidence_for_injection: 该补丁向 writeback 队列项中新增了显式的 flush 来源信息。
L2 流水线新增 is_restarted_flush 位，专门用于区分第一次经过和写回后的第二次 flush 处理。
l2_cache_update.sv 修改了 FLUSH_ACK 条件，不再允许脏命中的第一次经过直接确认。
notes: 这是适合用于一致性、栅栏和 DMA 可见性测试的高价值可迁移故障模式。
在该仓库内更简单的注入方式，是无视 l2r_needs_writeback，在第一次经过时就把 is_completed_flush 置真。
